title: Spicy Bombay Tofu Skillet with Potato, Tomato, Zucchini & Cilantro

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes, place in a large pot, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add both to the bowl.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl, sprinkle with cornstarch, and gently toss to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry, turning every few minutes, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tofu to a plate and return skillet to medium heat.
Add more oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish), tomatoes, pine nuts, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the skillet along with the tofu; stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the tofu skillet between plates or bowls and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
